entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary:
The Battle of Smolensk was a pivotal clash between the German Wehrmacht and the Soviet Red Army, occurring in the summer and early fall of 1941. 

This brutal and costly conflict, fought over Smolensk, a vital railway junction in western Russia, marked a turning point in the German invasion of the Soviet Union, codenamed Operation Barbarossa. 

The battle's outcome, a decisive Soviet victory, thwarted the German army's drive on Moscow and ultimately contributed to the failure of the German campaign. 

Smolensk's significance extends beyond the battle itself, as the city and its surroundings have been a focal point of human activity, from the Kievan Rus' to the present day.
